question: How can I add an announcement banner to my documentation site to highlight new features?
ground_truth: To add an announcement banner to your docs site, configure it in your docs.yml file with an announcement section containing a message field. The banner will appear at the top of your docs site and supports both Markdown and HTML formatting. After a user dismisses the banner, it will reappear when you update the announcement. You can also customize the banner's style using custom CSS.
